title: The mirrored Pascal pair: 10<sup>6</sup> list steps, and every near miss is a Lean-covered window
text: The Pascal machine's C++ list machine ran 10<sup>6</sup> list steps from the starts of 1RB1RA_1LC0RF_1LD1LC_1LE0LB_0LF---_1RA1RB and 1RB1RC_1RC1RB_1LD0RA_1LE1LD_1LF0LC_0LA--- without failing. In the first, all 5 times the head reads the last 1 during a crossing have near part b a b a^6 and a clean far part, the window that window_W3 (Lean) proves safe. In the second, that never happens at all.
